newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins up as half-yr profits top forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins up as half-yr profits top forecasts.

text.p: Shares in Tomkins Plc rose in pre-market trade on Monday after the baking-to-engineering conglomerate surpassed analysts' forecasts with half-year pre-tax profits of 168.8 million stg, up 34 percent.
By 0820 GMT, Tomkins shares were up five pence at 282-1/2, their highest level for three months, on volume of 369,000.
"The numbers were at the top end of what people were looking for and we've seen some early interest," one market-maker said.
Analysts had expected profits of around 160 million stg. The interim dividend was in line with expectations at 3.06p. Yet last week's speculation of a possible share buyback failed to be realised.
Executive chairman Greg Hutchings said prospects for the second half looked encouraging. "It is pleasing to report another period of outperformance for Tomkins," he said.
Tomkins shares rose last week after a "buy" recommendation from analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson.
